Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-01.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: You will need the Mark of Faith to change profession to a Cleric. It is given to people with true faith. By chance there is a task suitable to prove your faith if you would agree to give it a try?

links.text: Say you will take the task

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-04.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: I see you already have the Mark of Faith. If you meet High Priestess Levian , you can change profession.

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-07.html.text: Priest Zigaunt: You must bring a signed covenant from Lionel. Please hurry, the church wants to take care of this very quickly.

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-02.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: Oh. You are not a Mystic. I cannot give this errand to those who are not Mystics.

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-02a.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: You are already a Cleric that has proven your worthiness! You do not have to show your faith again. Please spread the teachings of the gods all over the world.

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-03.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: Thank you for your offer, but this job is too difficult for you right now. You need more experience. Let's talk again when you seen a little more of the world. (Only characters level 18 and above may embark on this quest.)

Q00405_PathOfTheCleric/30022-05.htm.text: Priest Zigaunt: By any chance, have you heard the rumors that there is a heretical book that criticizes our religion? The book is called "Understanding of Miracles," and it was actually written by a person who used to be a priest. That is why the church wants to take care of this problem quietly. C…

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30022-note.text: Priest Zigaunt: You have come to the wrong person. There is nothing I can teach you, unless you seek counseling regarding spiritual problems. May you be happy in the blessing of Einhasad.

ai/npc/Trainers/HealerTrainer/30022.html.text: Priest Zigaunt: Welcome in the name of Einhasad. This is a sacred place where we do all we can to save the poor souls of this region. We refuse aid to no one in real need. Now how can I help you?

You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!
